answer: Trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on the attestation graph, following supported paths rather than self-created identities. A Sybil cluster with few links to honest nodes has a low-conductance boundary; under fixed-degree and seed assumptions, conductance and min-cut bounds limit the probability that walks enter it, thereby bounding its aggregate voting weight despite many internal identities. meadow, island, and comet are merely node labels and confer no extra trust.
